Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.layout

Class LayoutResult.EdgeRoute

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.layout.LayoutResult.EdgeRoute
Enclosing class:
LayoutResult
public static final class LayoutResult.EdgeRoute extends Object
An edge: a piecewise cubic Bezier curve (1 + 3n points), the tips of its arrows when it has some, and the center of its label.

When an end has an arrow, the curve stops at the base of the arrow and the tip is given apart, as in Graphviz.
